card.title: IPad Air 4 Stuck on recovery mode

source.title: IPad Air 4 Stuck on recovery mode

symptoms: stuck in recovery after successful restore

claims.statement: An iPad Air 4 that restores successfully but reboots straight back into recovery mode can have a faulty power button flex; it boots normally with that flex unplugged.

procedure: Confirm restore succeeds but loops to recovery.
Unplug the power button flex and boot.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
